challenges.name: in-memory-user-store
challenges.title: Build an in-memory user store that keeps the contract
challenges.description: The signup tests used a quick fake that returned its own objects, compared emails with === and answered undefined for an unknown user - it agreed with the code, not with Postgres. Replace it with createInMemoryUserStore(): async insert, findByEmail and list, sequential ids, copies on the way in and out, case-insensitive unique emails rejected with code DUPLICATE_EMAIL, and null when nothing matches. The grader runs a contract suite against your store, then wires it to the shop's signup service and handleSignup handler and checks the 201, 409 and 400 responses.

tests.name: Contract: insert, findByEmail and list return promises, ids 1, 2, ... and the stored fields
Contract: changing an object passed in or returned never changes the stored rows
Contract: the same email in any case is rejected with an Error whose code is DUPLICATE_EMAIL
Contract: findByEmail ignores case and resolves to null for an unknown email
Integration: handleSignup with your store answers 201, 409 for a legacy mixed-case row, and 400
Integration: fresh stores, simultaneous signups and list order
